source.name: Unrecognized or blank countries must not save an old code
source.scope: Second post-hoc strengthening. Model run 2b863464 attempt 2 passed the native-form-visible task by editing the component blur handler, but a withheld check frozen before that inference showed typing "Fra" and leaving the field no longer saved France, and a reviewer probe showed the same patch throws on blur in the library standard (non-select) usage. The author added a plain pickup-city autocomplete to the consumer page and made both behaviours regression guards that must pass before and after every candidate. Guards are part of the gate and the model request; clear-shipping and clear-billing remain withheld. Pinned GOV.UK component unchanged. Not blind or production-customer evidence.

plan.root_cause: The accessible-autocomplete library does not update the underlying <select> value when the user types an unrecognized or blank value, causing the previously selected option to remain upon form submission.
plan.repair_strategy: Add synchronization logic for the country fields: after enhancing the selects, attach input/change/blur listeners to the autocomplete input that set the hidden select's value to the option's value when the input label matches an option, otherwise set it to empty.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard and screen‑reader users will see the form data reflect exactly what is shown in each country field, allowing correct clearing of selections and preventing hidden stale values from being submitted.
functional_risks: The added listeners may run after the library’s own update logic; there is a small risk of overriding a valid selection if the input temporarily contains a non‑matching value during composition, but the events used (input/change/blur) fire after composition ends, making this unlikely.
verification_requirements: Typing a recognized country label (e.g., "United Kingdom") updates the select’s value to the corresponding code ("gb").
Typing an unrecognized label (e.g., "Atlantis") or only spaces results in the select’s value being set to empty.
Selecting a country via arrow keys and Enter updates the select correctly.
Submitting the form after these interactions yields the expected form‑data values as per the test assertions.
